description: Point whatsapi.sh at an https URL and start receiving events there. The answer carries the signing secret ONCE, on first registration: keep it. Every delivery is signed with it in the `x-whatsapi-signature` header (`t=<unix>,v1=<hmac-sha256 of "<t>.<body>">`), and that signature is how you know a request is really from us. Calling this again updates the URL or the subscription and keeps the same secret unless you ask to rotate it. Saving also re-enables an endpoint we had disabled. Free.

events.description: Which events to receive: message.created, message.sent, message.failed, message.status, number.connected, number.disconnected, number.logged_out, number.history_synced. Defaults to all of them.

rotateSecret.description: Mint a new signing secret and return it. The old one stops working.
